title: Storm Boelo to bring gusts of up to 80mph and heavy rain to parts of UK
summary_full: Second named storm in as many days will hit northern parts of UK as thousands remain without power after Friday’s Storm AustenThe UK is bracing for a second storm this weekend, as strong winds and heavy rain are expected to disrupt travel and cause further power cuts in the north.Storm Boelo, the second named storm of the season, is expected to bring heavy, frequent showers and winds potentially exceeding 80mph to northern parts of the UK.
